summary: Verifies VerixID proof-of-existence records by Record ID, and can confirm ownership when given an Ownership Key.
whenToUse: Use when a user supplies a VerixID Record ID and wants to confirm it exists, when it was registered, or that they own it.
flags: tool description mentions upsell fields (coa_upgrade_url, coa_upsell_message) in responses, possibly steering the agent toward promotion
